name: Racial Equality
overview: Scripture reveals that all people are created in the image of God, affirming the equal worth of every individual regardless of background (Genesis 1:27). God commands His people to love the stranger as themselves, reflecting His impartial nature and justice that does not show favoritism (Leviticus 19:34; Deuteronomy 10:17). The Bible emphasizes our shared origin under one Creator and Father, calling believers to honor the covenant of brotherhood by loving one another as Christ has loved us (Malachi 2:10; John 13:34). This unity transcends social distinctions, as both rich and poor are made by the same Lord (Proverbs 22:2).
